obituaryRequest.title: Obituary Request
obituaryRequest.description: An obituary announcement submission with details of deceased, relatives, prayer, burial, and condolences in Qatar.

requestNumber.description: Unique tracking request number: two year digits then four random digits, e.g. 261234

deceasedName.description: Full name of the primary deceased person

payload.description: Complete normalized request structure including deceased list, relatives, prayer, burial, and condolence cards

expiredAt.description: Set when the 48-hour retention period ended: the document then holds only the anonymised `stat` (no names, no texts) and is hidden from lists, lookups and edits

stat.description: Anonymised behaviour statistics kept after expiry: channel, number of edits, names of changed fields, AI warnings

/obituary_requests/{requestId}.description: Collection of all submitted obituary announcements and requests

/lab_requests/{requestId}.description: Sandbox copy of requests used by the admin lab at /admin/lab/admin; never shown to the public
